milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the dark oak planks building (centered at ~8,2,9) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows spotting the large structure from a reasonable distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it. The building spans ~3,0,4 to ~13,4,14 so it's visible from far away.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must enter the building and navigate close to the gray wall banner at ~4,2,5 (just inside the entrance on the west wall, facing east). max_distance=8 requires the player to be inside or at the entrance of the building, facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate deeper into the L-shaped corridor to reach the light gray wall banner at ~9,2,11 (on the south wall section, facing north). max_distance=8 requires navigating through the corridor turn, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the deepest point of the corridor where gold ore blocks are placed at ~11-12,1-2,12 and face toward them. max_distance=8 requires reaching the end of the L-shaped corridor past the light gray banner, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the gold ore.
